summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs (identifier-mangled) downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the host platform, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (WV8StW shifter over a numeric/string dictionary) and hex-mangled identifiers; it is not referenced by the package's declared library entry dist/index.js and its name does not correspond to any documented functionality of a widget-platform library. Executing the obfuscated payload through a freshly downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node prevents Node-based install-time analysis from observing the payload's behavior. The @servicetitan scope's package is authored across versions by a single personal account (karpoff-titan / Anton Karpov), with the preinstall dropper and math_init.js absent from src/ and appearing only in recent versions while earlier CHANGELOG entries describe ordinary widget-platform work — a shape consistent with maintainer/scope compromise affecting downstream consumers of @servicetitan/*.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
